title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
statement: A sorted array of distinct values was rotated at some unknown pivot. Return the index of target, or -1. Must run in logarithmic time.
hints: Even after rotation, at least one half of any subrange is still sorted.
Compare nums[lo] with nums[mid] to work out which half is the sorted one.
If target lies inside that sorted half range, search there; otherwise search the other half.
